concept_updates.description: A monetary amount, with observed values expressed in US dollars.
An assessment of a price, exemplified by describing a flight option as somewhat expensive.
An endpoint for sending information, exemplified by the user's email address.
A merchandise item, exemplified by a tablet.
A commerce order, including recent and numbered orders in the observed examples.
A request to return a product, exemplified by a tablet return.
A request to cancel a product order, exemplified by a charger cancellation.
A method used to receive or make a payment, exemplified by an existing gift card.
A stated reason for cancelling an order, exemplified by no longer being needed.
An action executed through a commerce tool, such as cancelling an order or returning delivered items.
A specific item within an order, identified by an item number in the examples.
A gift card used as a refund destination.
A status describing an executed tool action, such as a submitted return request.
A category of identifier, exemplified by an order number.
A concrete identifier used to locate an order, exemplified by a shoe order number.
A product size, exemplified by shoe size 6.
A product color, exemplified by black.
A material from which a product is made, exemplified by synthetic material.
A status of an order, exemplified by delivered.
A decision under discussion, exemplified by choosing an executor for a will.
A calendar date associated with a legal event or a user-provided time anchor.
A physical place where an event occurs, such as a cafe or the user's home.
A concern about a decision or its effect on family members.
An event intended to occur in the future, exemplified by a new family meeting.
A mode of interaction, exemplified by face-to-face discussion.
The subject discussed in an event, exemplified by executor selection.
An option considered in planning, exemplified by a co-executor arrangement.
A request for a task to be performed, exemplified by drafting meeting materials.
A general document, exemplified by a meeting invitation.
A proposed schedule containing dates, times, and places.
A document with legal significance, exemplified by the user's will.
A person's emotional state, exemplified by feeling substantial pressure.
A legal status, exemplified by whether a will has legal effect.
A provision in a legal document, exemplified by appointing Douglas as executor.
A draft legal text, exemplified by the text of a will.
A law applicable to a legal formality such as signing or witnessing.
A formal legal procedure, exemplified by signing.
An action of reviewing a legal document, exemplified by lawyer review.
A decision with legal significance, exemplified by appointing a guardian.
A plan for managing an estate, including the effects of a guardianship designation.

operator_updates.description: Relates information reported as sent to the user's email endpoint.
Relates sent information to the flight option it describes.
Expresses that one product is described as compatible with another product.
Relates a return or cancellation request to the product it targets.
Represents refund destination information across requests, tool actions, products, payment methods, and gift cards.
Relates a cancellation request or cancellation tool action to its stated reason.
Represents a user authorizing a commerce tool action.
Relates a commerce tool action to an order or order item on which it operates.
Relates a tool action or order to its status, with distinct action and order status types in the samples.
Relates a commerce tool action to the monetary amount reported as refunded.
Relates a refund amount to the gift card to which it is returned.
Relates a return request to the identifier type used to locate its item.
Expresses a tentative association between a product and a possible order.
Captures a user's stated inability to recall an identifier; its negated epistemic form needs downstream modeling review.
Relates an order to the person whose order it is.
Relates a product to its product size.
Relates a product to its color.
Relates a product to its material.
Relates a person to a decision, concern, or estate plan that is a subject of worry in the samples.
Relates a person or group to an event or planned event in which they participate.
Relates an event or legal decision to its calendar date.
Relates an event to the place where it occurs.
Relates a person to an event they attend.
Relates a planned event to the topic discussed at it.
Relates planning entities to options or roles they are advised to consider.
Relates a planned event to a situation that motivates it.
Relates documents or legal arrangements to schedules or financial arrangements they specify.
Expresses a possible concern associated with a person in a proposed agenda.
Expresses that a person is obligated to complete a legal document.
Relates a legal document to the calendar date by which it must be completed.
Relates a user-provided time anchor to its calendar date; the person-as-subject form needs review.
Relates a person to an emotional state they report experiencing.
Expresses that a person has completed an event, such as a family meeting.
Represents a person seeking a legal status for a document.
Relates a plan to a deadline used to schedule its progress; the direction is retained from the source draft.
Relates a legal formality to the law governing it.
Relates a legal review action to the legal document it reviews.
Relates a professional role to the review action it performs.
Relates a plan to a legal formality for which the plan reserves time.
Represents a person making a legal decision, such as a guardianship designation.

notes: All 40 concept IDs and 40 operator IDs from payload-003 are covered; no IDs were created.
Overloaded or directionally questionable relations are retained with broad or needs_review status rather than given misleading tight schemas.
Operator schemas use only names present in payload-003 concept_catalog.
